mods.name: Changed
mods.desc: The base mod. Latex creatures, labs, emotes and the transfur system, where you become a creature and gain its perks and drawbacks. Forge 1.20.1 and 1.18.2.

mods.name: Changed-V
mods.desc: Official addon that adds an anthropomorphic version of vanilla mobs. Creeper and Spider forms are out; Guardian and Ghast are planned.

mods.name: Changed Addon Plus
mods.desc: The biggest addon. Survival untransfur items, grab mechanics, new transfurs, Painite and Iridium ores, new structures, and bosses like Experiment 009 and 010.

mods.name: Changed Additions
mods.desc: Extra content for Changed that keeps a vanilla look and feel.

mods.name: Changed: Synergy
mods.desc: Makes latex creatures social, with names, personalities, factions and reputation. Befriend them, bond with them, build an outpost, or negotiate your way out of a transfur.

mods.name: Changed Extra
mods.desc: Adds a tech system based on "Latex Power" and expands Latex Space into a dimension with regional weather hazards. Updated Oct 9.

mods.name: Changed Extras
mods.desc: Early access. Adds things that don't fit in Changed or the main addon, like characters and species from other verses (the Conekat, plus a cafeteria room in the facilities). Includes an optional smarter latex AI, off by default.

mods.name: Changed Siren Course
mods.desc: A water curse that turns you into a shark mermaid or merman on contact with water. Adds a wetness meter, a new structure, items and original music.

mods.name: Changed: True Transfur
mods.desc: A new addon described as a full transformation system with an "INSTINCT" mode.

mods.name: Additional Transfurs
mods.desc: A few simple transfurs (Latex Fox, Red Tail Catfish, Rooftop Cat, Plant Dragon), built as one piece of a modular addon set. Early beta.

mods.name: Changed Untransfur
mods.desc: A simple untransfur mod, kept separate so you only add it if you want it.

mods.name: (Un)Safe Transfur
mods.desc: A mod about getting transfurred in less-than-safe ways.

mods.name: Latex's Delight
mods.desc: A Farmer's Delight extension that adapts Changed items and creatures. No official server; the owner and a dev are in the Changed Additions+ server.

mods.name: Changed: Survive Protocol
mods.desc: A survival rework: coverage, then infection, then transfur. Adds lab cures, a lucidity system, stabilization items and spreading Latex Hearts.

mods.name: FurMutage Early Testing
mods.desc: Early access. Makes Dark and White latex more complex, with ruined structures and a wasteland dimension (creative-only for now). Warns of disturbing imagery.

mods.name: Create: Changed
mods.desc: Early alpha that lets Changed, Addon Plus and Additions items be made with Create machinery.

mods.name: Changed Pooltoys TFs
mods.desc: Work in progress that adds a pooltoy variant of transfurs, with inflation, pumps and a translator item.

mods.name: Latex Caves
mods.desc: A datapack-turned-mod that adds the Latex Caves dimension, entered through a Time Machine structure.

mods.name: Changed AI Boss
mods.desc: Beta. Connects Experiment 009, Experiment 010 and Void Fox to an LLM for live battle dialogue. Client-side, bring your own API key.

mods.name: changedarmy
mods.desc: Brand new. Adds latex creature squads that hunt players, and hostile outposts with loot.

mods.name: GoopcatTech
mods.desc: A small tech mod from the Latex Caves developer, described as the "strangest but cutest" tech mod around.

mods.name: Peos Custom Transfurs
mods.desc: Custom transfurs (teal dragon, mice, Mylo panda, Forsetti, Drone Wolf) and a shrink-and-grow ability. Needs Pehkui. Last update Jun 2026.

mods.name: Changed: Xtras
mods.desc: Weapons (TSC and police batons, steel gear), ores and mutated latex bottles. Made with MCreator, last updated Jul 2024. No versions available.

mods.name: Changed: Doomsday
mods.desc: Difficulty gamerules, configs and datapacks, like permanently hostile latexes and armed minibosses. 1.18.2 only, last updated Sep 2025.

mods.name: Changed: More Music Discs
mods.desc: Adds survival-friendly music discs. Same author as Doomsday, last updated Jul 2025.
